GhatWatch brief: Durga visarjan 20 October 2026 (9 days left)

Highest-risk ghats (Durga tables, 2023-2025):
- Bairagarh (Sant Hirdaram) kund: Tier 1. 12 of 18 readings outside CPCB class B; zero dissolved oxygen recorded. No Durga 2025 data.
  Action: Test before, during and after Durga visarjan.
- Malikhedi kund: Tier 1. 11 of 18 readings outside CPCB class B; lowest DO 4 mg/l. No Durga 2025 data.
  Action: Test before, during and after Durga visarjan.
- Shahpura lake ghat: Tier 1 (tied with Khatlapura ghat). 14 of 27 readings outside CPCB class B; lowest DO 2.5 mg/l.
  Action: Priority.

Data gaps: no Durga 2025 data for Bairagarh (Sant Hirdaram) kund and Malikhedi kund. Missing is not a clean result.

Recommended actions:
- Test before, during and after Durga visarjan (no 2025 Durga data). Keep aeration and cleaning on standby.
- Priority: arrange aeration and extra cleaning, and test water before, during and after visarjan.

Limits: readings compared with CPCB class B limits for pH, DO and BOD only; coliform not tested. No health conclusions; past readings do not predict the day.
Source: MPPCB Ganesh/Durga visarjan reports 2023-2025; page references in the dashboard.
